subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept Codex-style structured questions, plan mode, and goal-mode continuation as core runtime features now, and should the paired implementation be reviewed as one branch or split?
rationale: The request adds cross-surface core runtime behavior, UI/channel rendering, tool-gate policy, and a continuation driver, so the remaining blocker is maintainer product and ownership intent rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Split staged core PRs
options.body: Keep this issue open and review question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver work as staged PRs with focused proof for each surface.

options.title: Sponsor the full branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the broad review cost and upgrade/security proof burden for the paired implementation PR as one branch.

options.title: Defer or narrow
options.body: Maintainers can narrow this to one primitive or defer the roadmap if the core surface is not ready now.

recommendation.title: Split staged core PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and review question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver work as staged PRs with focused proof for each surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter's adjacent strict-agentic policy history makes him the best available owner for the core runtime direction decision.
